description:
The successful candidate will combine engineering expertise with experience deploying advanced digital technologies to accelerate product development, improve engineering productivity, and enhance product performance. This role will serve as the technical leader for the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), Generative Design, and Digital Thread capabilities across Component Design & Analyses (CDA) teams in Engines & Power Systems (EPS) Strategic Business Group.

 As a recognized technical authority, the Chief Engineer will partner with component teams, systems engineering, data science, advanced technology, and Chief Technology Office, to establish next-generation engineering methodologies that transform how turbine-engines and energy systems are designed.

 The ideal candidate combines deep physics-based engineering expertise with a passion for AI, digital transformation, and modern product development methods, enabling the organization to fundamentally reinvent how next-generation engines and power systems are created.

 The candidate will report to the Sr Director of Engineering for Component Design & Analysis at the Phoenix, AZ location.

 
 
 
  

 

 



 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Develop and execute a multi-year digital engineering roadmap for turbomachinery component design. 
 Modernize engineering workflows, tools, and processes to achieve digital engineering and development assurance objectives consistent with ARP4754 and similar regulatory guidance. 
 Define standards, processes, and governance for digital engineering adoption across component design teams. 
 Drive adoption of MBSE and model-based product development methodologies. 
 Enable digital thread connectivity between requirements, architecture, design artifacts, analyses, test results, and certification evidence.  
 Develop workforce capability in AI, digital engineering, automation, and advanced analytics.  
 Lead the application of AI and Machine Learning to engineering workflows and product design. 
 Champion the use of machine-learning models, and AI-enhanced analysis techniques to reduce design cycle time. 
 Establish strategic partnerships to accelerate adoption of digital-engineering and AI-enabled design processes 
 Monitor industry trends and benchmark leading digital engineering practices. 
  




 YOU MUST HAVE 
 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as the sciences, technology, engineering or mathematics 
 10+ years of experience in software/methods development for product design 
  
 WE VALUE 
 Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related discipline.  
 Experience leading enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives.  
 Demonstrated implementation of AI/ML technologies in engineering design environments.  
 Expertise in the following:  MBSE and Digital Thread 
 Development Assurance 
 Autonomous Engineering Process Orchestration 
 Cloud computing and high-performance computing environments 
 CAD, CFD, FEA methods 
 Python, CAD automation APIs (NXOpen or equivalent) 
 Generative AI enablers (LLM, MCP, MLOps, RAG, Ontologies) 
 Physics-Informed Machine Learning and Data-Driven Surrogate Modeling 
 Digital engineering tools (Matlab/Simulink, IBM ELM, Doors NG, Syndeia, Cameo) 
 
  
 BENEFITS​ 
 Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:​ 
 ​ 
 Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance​ 
 Short-term and long-term disability coverage​ 
 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts​ 
 Employee assistance program and educational assistance​ 
 Parental leave and 12 paid holidays​ 
 Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time ​ 
 ​ 
 Explore your benefits:  https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/ ​ 
 ​ 
 POSTING TIMELINE​ 
 The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates.​ 
  
 ABOUT US 
  
 Engines & Power Systems:​ 
 ​ 
 Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board. ​ 
 ​ 
 As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses:  https://www.honeywellaerospace.com ​ 
 ​ 
 Engines & Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep aircraft flying. With engines across roughly 120 aircraft types and more than 47,000 APUs in service today, we support operators across commercial and defense markets — backed by an aftermarket network built for the long service life of every platform we power.​ 
  
  
  
 U.S. CITIZENSHIP REQUIREMENTS 
 ​ 
 Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status.
